crossRefs.note: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for Yahweh’s wave offering.
Yahweh spoke to Aaron, “Behold, I myself have given you the command of my wave offerings, even all the holy things of…
All the wave offerings of the holy things which the children of Israel offer to Yahweh, I have given you and your sons…
Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.
or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope…
But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.
Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.
Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham, the patriarch, gave a tenth out of the best plunder.
We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,

people.name: Eleazar
people.line: Son of Aaron, high priest after his father

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses gave the tribute, which was Yahweh’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
translations.bsb: Moses gave the tribute to Eleazar the priest as an offering for the LORD, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD'S heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.asv: And Moses gave the tribute, which was Jehovah's heave-offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as Jehovah commanded Moses.
